name: Record the 3.7.2 fixes in the companion docs
request: Record the 3.7.2 fixes in the companion docs
checks: npm run check passed (typecheck, build, 373 tests, validate)
result: Documentation only, no code touched. Bumped version and build id to 3.7.2 in all five places plus manifest and package. CHANGELOG.md gained a 3.7.2 entry describing all three live defects and their causes: the panel resolving to a container that held the applicant list so the first line of its text became every record's name, the row click waiting on signals that do not mean the panel re-rendered, and the resume route being stored and downloaded as a document. CHECKS.md gained a 3.7.2 section with the four commands actually run, the nine new tests and what each asserts, and a plain statement that the 3.7.1 suite passed 364 tests while all three defects were happening - which is what the standing phase-30 warning is for - plus four things only a live run can confirm about the fixes. MEMORY.md gained three durable entries (never take the first line as a name, a row click is not a rendered panel, a LinkedIn page is not a resume file), PROJECT_STATUS.md leads with the three defects, and TECH_STACK.md gained two constraints and the new test count.
